content: WorkOS AuthKit supports JIT (just-in-time) org provisioning: if a signing-up user's email domain matches a verified org domain, they're auto-added to that org; otherwise a new org can be auto-created for them (B2B apps want every user inside an org context). Clerk allows users to create organizations by default (can be restricted to admin-provisioned only). Neither vendor's docs surfaced explicit rename/merge/de-dup flows in this search -- that logic is left to the app layer.
